entries.question: How long do I have to return an item?
entries.answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. The item must be unused and in its original packaging. Final-sale items, gift cards, and perishable goods cannot be returned.

entries.question: How do I start a return?
entries.answer: Open your order in the Orders page and choose Return this item. We email you a prepaid shipping label within one business day. Drop the parcel at any carrier location; no appointment is needed.

entries.question: When will I get my refund after returning something?
entries.answer: Refunds are issued within 3 business days of the return arriving at our warehouse. Your bank may take a further 5 to 10 business days to post the credit to your statement.

entries.question: My item arrived damaged or faulty. What should I do?
entries.answer: Report it within 48 hours of delivery through the Orders page, with photographs of the damage. We ship a replacement immediately at no cost and do not require the damaged item to be returned first.

entries.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or colour?
entries.answer: We do not process exchanges directly. Return the original item for a refund and place a new order for the size or colour you want. Placing the new order right away is the fastest route, since stock is not reserved during a return.

entries.question: How long does delivery take?
entries.answer: Standard delivery arrives in 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery arrives the next business day when ordered before 2pm local time. Remote addresses may add 1 to 2 days.

entries.question: How much does shipping cost?
entries.answer: Standard shipping is free on orders over 50 dollars and 4.90 dollars below that. Express shipping is 12.90 dollars regardless of order value.

entries.question: How do I track my order?
entries.answer: A tracking link is emailed when your parcel leaves our warehouse, and the same link appears on the order in your account. Tracking can take up to 12 hours to show its first scan after dispatch.

entries.question: Do you ship internationally?
entries.answer: We ship to 34 countries. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days. Import duties and taxes are not included in the order total and are collected by the carrier on delivery.

entries.question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
entries.answer: The address can be changed only while the order status is still Preparing. Once it shows Dispatched the parcel is with the carrier and the address is fixed; you would need to refuse delivery and reorder.

entries.question: What payment methods do you accept?
entries.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Bank transfer is available for business accounts on request.

entries.question: My payment was declined. Why?
entries.answer: The most common causes are an expired card, a billing address that does not match your bank's records, and your bank's fraud check. We never see the specific reason your bank gave. Try a different payment method or contact your bank.

entries.question: I was charged twice for one order.
entries.answer: A duplicate line on your statement is usually a pending authorisation rather than a second charge, and it disappears within 5 business days. If both entries have settled, contact us with both transaction dates and we will refund the duplicate.

entries.question: Can I get an invoice or receipt for my order?
entries.answer: A receipt is emailed when your order is confirmed. A formal invoice with your company name and tax number can be downloaded from the order page once the order has shipped.

entries.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
entries.answer: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. If the email does not arrive, check your spam folder and confirm you are using the address the account was created with.

entries.question: How do I delete my account?
entries.answer: Request deletion from Settings, then Privacy. We remove your personal data within 30 days. Order records are retained for 7 years where tax law requires it, with personal identifiers removed.

entries.question: Why can't I see an old order in my account?
entries.answer: Order history shows the last 24 months. Older orders are archived; contact support with the approximate date and we can retrieve the record.

entries.question: When can I reach a human agent?
entries.answer: Human agents are available Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Singapore time, excluding public holidays. Outside those hours you can leave a message and we reply on the next business day.
